newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles health dept sees deficit at $123 mln.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles health dept sees deficit at $123 mln.

text.p: Los Angeles County's health department warned that it could face a $123.1 million deficit in fiscal year 1997-1998, county officials said Wednesday.
The $123 million deficit forecast was down from an earlier estimate by the Department of Health Services. In March, the department projected a fiscal 1997-1998 deficit of $141.4 million.
The department said the $18.3 million improvement in the forecast reflects in part a net reduction in the department's employee benefits projection, according to county health officials.
The department issues regular updates on its financial condition to the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. Fiscal year 1997-1998 will begin on July 1.
